title.narrative: Number of public/media/communication campaigns designed and implemented

description.narrative: Number of public/media/communication campaigns designed and implemented

comment.narrative: It will be 3 if the duration of all of them is 6 months 2 if there is one of 6 months and the other annual

The final number of campaigns implemented 2 is lower than the target 3 however with the agreement of the FPI Programme Manager one campaign was replaced by support for the organization of two events Samvad A Dialogue a cultural event specifically celebrating 60 years of EUIndia relations and the EU Film Festival where support was provided for its social media campaign helping the outreach. During the second year two campaigns were developed 1 Social Media Campaign for the 2023 EUIndia Young Leaders Exchange The materials of campaign highlighted the importance of EUIndia relations focusing on youth engagement and showcased the Young Leaders views and contributions to future cooperation. The target audience included young professionals policymakers and the general public in both regions. Materials were prepared during the first half of 2023 and submitted in December. 1 Study in Europe campaign around EHEVF and Erasmus Mundus. The campaign promoted Europe as an ideal destination for higher education emphasizing benefits such as cultural diversity academic excellence and career opportunities. It featured testimonials from Indian students studying in Europe to build trust while providing detailed information about participating institutions study programs funding options and more. The target audience included Indian students interested in studying abroad both in traditional media and on social media platforms with a focus on users in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. Also the campaign targeted mentors parents teachers educationists and working professionals. It started at the beginning of 2023 but materials were prepared during the second half of 2023 and ran until December. Messages Testimonials from Erasmus scholars registration posts Countdown to the actual date of event Member State wise content highlighting the participating institutions from each MS Content highlighting reasons Why Europe
